title: Monopoles, duality, and large charge in Chern-Simons QED$_3$
summary: We compute the scaling dimensions of charge $q$ monopole operators in QED$_3$ with $N$ two-component complex fermions and Chern-Simons level $k$, to subleading order in the limit where $k,N$ are large and $k/N$ is fixed. We use this and previous results for scalar QED$_3$ (sQED$_3$) to check the duality between QED$_3$ with $N=1,k=-3/2$ and sQED$_3$ with $N=1,k=2$, whose $U(1)$ monopole symmetry is enhanced to $SO(3)$.
